title: Applications to Import Embryos Back to Singapore for Assisted Reproductive Technology Procedures
what_it_is: Applications to Import Embryos Back to Singapore for Assisted Reproductive Technology Procedures

sections.label: Embryo import applications outcomes
sections.summary: MOH received 62 applications to import embryos for Assisted Reproduction; 59 succeeded and three failed regulatory requirements like egg donor age limits.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Since the process was established in June 2021 to review applications to import embryos back to Singapore for Assisted Reproduction treatment for couples affected by the COVID-19 travel restrictions, MOH has received 62 such applications.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Of these, 59 applications were successful; three were unsuccessful.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Three were unsuccessful as they did not meet the regulatory requirements stipulated in the Licensing Terms and Conditions for Assisted Reproduction Services, such as exceeding the allowed egg donor age limit.

sections.label: Rejection rate for embryo applications
sections.summary: Of 62 applications, 59 were successful, so rejection was not high and resulted from not meeting licensing terms and conditions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: I know their concerns and the urgency of such situations.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: I would just like to highlight though that I mentioned earlier that there were 62 applications in total, 59 were successful.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: So, it is not really a high rate of rejection and really, the rejection was as a result of not meeting the regulatory requirements stipulated in our licensing terms and conditions for Assisted Reproduction (AR) services.

sections.label: Online appeal form and circular
sections.summary: MOH developed an online application form for appeals and issued a circular on 3 June 2021 setting conditions for importing gametes or embryos.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: To facilitate the MOH review of the increasing number of appeals at that juncture, MOH developed an online application form, specifically for the purposes of such appeals.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: A circular was issued on 3 June 2021 to all licensees providing AR services under the Private Hospitals and Medical Clinics Act that set up the conditions for appealing to import gametes or embryos during the COVID-19 travel restrictions and the information that MOH would require the information required to carry out its review.
